description: This file contains an async function that handles OAuth2 proxy requests within a FastAPI application. It reads configuration mappings, extracts headers from incoming requests, processes the data (including conversions), and constructs a UserAPIKeyAuth object.

classes.name: UserAPIKeyAuth
classes.description: A data model representing user API key authentication details, constructed from request headers based on OAuth2 configuration mappings.

methods.name: UserAPIKeyAuth handle_oauth2_proxy_request(request: Request)
methods.description: Processes an incoming OAuth2 proxy request, extracts headers according to configuration mappings, and returns a UserAPIKeyAuth object with the extracted data.
